Subject: Archer portal - CAIQ batch ingest & S3 connector options

Hi Jonas / Laura,

Thanks again for taking this on — BluePeak is moving fast and our procurement team asked whether Archer supports a bulk CAIQ import and an automated S3 connector for evidence artifacts. We currently have: 
- a filled CAIQ spreadsheet (attached: caiq_answers_v1.xlsx)
- an S3 bucket (us-west-2) with PDFs/screenshots organized by control ID

Questions:
1) Can Archer do a bulk CAIQ mapping and ingestion, or do you recommend we push artifacts into an S3 manifest for your team to pick up?
2) Are there least-privilege policies we should apply to the bucket when giving Redwood/Archer read access?
3) Any preferred filename conventions or metadata you need (e.g., control_id, evidence_type)?

We'd like to keep the initial onboarding light — ideally a one-day ingest and then follow-up validation from BluePeak. Can you propose a plan and ETA?

Thanks,
Daniel
Daniel Perez
Head of Ops, BluePeak Analytics
From: jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai>
To: Daniel Perez <daniel@bluepeak.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, mina_haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.ai>, olga_petrov <olga_petrov@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 22 May 2026 10:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Archer portal - CAIQ batch ingest & S3 connector options

Hi Daniel — appreciate the clear summary and attaching the CAIQ. Short answer: we can support both approaches but recommend a staged S3 manifest + bulk CAIQ mapping so we can validate answers against artifacts before finalizing the profile in Archer. Proposed plan below.

Plan (high level)
1) Redwood provides a CAIQ mapping template (CSV) you populate with your CAIQ answer IDs and any local answer tags. (see attached: caiq_mapping_template.csv)
2) BluePeak uploads artifacts to a dedicated S3 prefix and drops a manifest (s3_manifest_template.json) listing object keys, control_id, and evidence_type. We will request least-priv read-only presigned URLs for initial ingest if you prefer ephemeral access.
3) Our security team will run the ingest into a sandbox Archer profile, validate 10-15 sample mappings with BluePeak, then promote to production.

Technical notes for your SRE:
- Recommended IAM: one role with S3:GetObject scoped to arn:aws:s3:::bluepeak-onboarding/* and a short-lived access key for Redwood ingestion.
- Filename metadata: include controlId in filename or as manifest field (preferred). Example object key: onboarding/CAIQ/CP-02_evidence.pdf

I copied Mina and Olga from our security/onboarding teams — Mina will own the mapping review and Olga will handle the actual API-based ingest into Archer. Can you confirm the S3 region, how you prefer to grant access (presigned URL vs. temp IAM creds), and a target two-day window for initial upload?

Attachments: caiq_mapping_template.csv

Best,
Jonas Weber
Director, Customer Security & Compliance
Redwood Inference

On Fri, May 22, 2026 at 10:02 AM jonas_weber <jonas_weber@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Jonas: Proposed plan below.
>
Thanks — quick technical follow-up and an example manifest.

We prefer manifest-driven ingest because it keeps provenance clear and avoids partial/duplicate uploads. Attached is s3_manifest_template.json and a short implementation note (archer_bulk_ingest_instructions.pdf). Key requirements: 
- Manifest schema: list of objects with fields {object_key, control_id, evidence_type, md5_hex}
- Presigned URL approach: good for initial onboarding. Please provide presigned URLs that are valid for 24 hours and scoped to the specific key(s).
- Security control: supply an S3 bucket policy that only allows GetObject from specific agents; we will not ask for bucket-level delete or list.

Validation: we will pick a sample set (20 items) to verify control mapping and then run the full import. Expected turnaround: 48 hours from receipt of manifest + sample artifacts.

Action items for BluePeak
- Populate caiq_mapping_template.csv (control answer -> local evidence reference)
- Upload artifacts under onboarding/bluepeak/ and drop manifest in onboarding/bluepeak/manifest.json OR provide presigned URLs 
- Reply with preferred access method and a target upload date/time

Attachments: s3_manifest_template.json, archer_bulk_ingest_instructions.pdf

Thanks,
Mina Haddad
Sr. Security Engineer (Onboarding)
Redwood Inference
